About
Me

Hello, I am Shannon, a fresh graduate and newly licensed Civil Engineer. My training covered reading plans and preparing quantity takeoffs, but the part I do best is the numbers, documentation, and coordination that keep a project on track.

I am starting my career as a Virtual Assistant for construction teams. I am familiar with terms like RFI, shop drawing, submittal, and punch list, and I am ready to learn your workflows and preferences.

I am new to the field, but I bring a civil engineering license, the skills to read your plans, and a careful eye for detail. I can help turn your emails, plans, and project paperwork into organized records and clear quantities, so you can focus on the work that moves the project forward.

What I can take off your plate

Pick one task or hand over the whole back office. Either way, you get dependable, organized support.

Project administration

Permits tracking, submittals, RFIs, change orders, and daily logs kept up to date and easy to find.

Scheduling and coordination

Site visits, inspections, subcontractor calendars, and reminders managed to keep your project on schedule.

Estimates and documents

Material lists, bid package prep, and organized project documents ready when you need them.

Client and vendor communication

Email and phone follow-ups, status updates, and supplier orders handled professionally on your behalf.

Data entry and file organization

Accurate spreadsheets, well-organized cloud folders, and consistent file naming for every project.

Takeoff and plan support

Reading plans and preparing architectural and structural quantity takeoffs and material lists.
